interface.longDescription: Turn a conversation into a readable HTML document. Brief, Editorial and Report are separate layouts with different typography and structure. Each exported file includes a reader-controlled colour menu, embedded images, Markdown tables, section navigation and print styles. Includes a bundled renderer and layout templates. File creation needs a session with file tools; Node or Bun enables automatic rendering, with an HTML template fallback.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Idea Zone to turn this conversation into a polished, shareable HTML document.

name: idea-zone
description: Turn conversations into single-file HTML documents with tables, embedded images, separate layouts and reader-controlled colours.
